data.name: Space Recycle
data.detailed_description:
Space Recycle is a multiplayer simulation game where you and your friend build your own recycling operation in the depths of space. Collect drifting objects, transform them into valuable resources, sell your products, fulfill special orders, earn profits, and expand your business by upgrading your equipment.

COLLECT

Gather organic and inorganic objects drifting through space using a variety of collection tools. Stay connected to the station and safely transport resources to the recycling machines.

RECYCLE

Process the materials you've collected using specialized recycling machines. Turn organic waste into burgers and inorganic materials into fuel.

SELL

Set the prices of your products and generate income through sales. Increase your profits by fulfilling special orders and managing your production process efficiently.

STORE

Save space and resources by storing the objects you've collected in the storage chest. Keep your operation organized and ready for future production.

UPGRADE

Use your earnings to upgrade your collection equipment and recycling machines. Gather more resources and improve your productivity.

HAVE FUN

Cooperation doesn't always go as planned! Use the Electroshock Device to playfully sabotage your friend and create hilarious, unexpected moments.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Intel i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

Recommended:
